origin.claim: Short-horizon reversal: abrupt one-interval price jumps in thin binary books routinely overshoot because the first wave of flow consumes several levels; prediction-market write-ups treat post-jump entries as a recurring, testable pattern.
origin.status: hypothesis under test - tick-to-tick, on official snapshot mids only

rules.entry: |mid change between the previous committed snapshot and this one| >= 6 cents, spread <= 4 cents, at least 2 hours to close, mid between 0.08 and 0.92.
rules.exit: Exit when the mid retraces half of the measured jump, or the market closes.
rules.sizing: Target notional, capped by verified depth.

thesis: When a contract's official mid moves by 6 cents or more between two consecutive verified snapshots, take the opposite side: fade the jump. Deliberately distinct from @vol-crusher (which fades daily-candle extremes from the exchange candle history), this acts on tick-to-tick snapshot moves.
